checkedAlternates.risk: Hypoid gears look almost identical to spiral bevel gears.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Hypoid gear shafts are offset and do not intersect (group-2), whereas spiral bevel shafts intersect at a point (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: Crossed helical gears can connect skew shafts.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Standard helical gears are primarily used for parallel-shaft power transmission (group-4).
